profile.name: Lakshmi Chaitanya Reddy Idamakanti
profile.title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
profile.tagline: I build the workflows, integrations and custom applications that make ServiceNow actually work for the people using it — across CSM, HRSD and ITSM, with {{years}}+ years of production delivery behind me.
about: I'm a ServiceNow developer with {{years}}+ years of experience designing and shipping solutions across Customer Service Management, HRSD and ITSM. Most of my work sits where the platform meets everything else: eBonding integrations, CMDB alignment, REST/SOAP services, and the custom scripting that holds a real business process together.

Day to day that means Flow Designer automations, Script Includes and Business Rules written to be readable a year later, Service Portal widgets and UI Builder components, and integration layers designed to be reused rather than rebuilt for every customer. I care about ITIL-sane process design, ACLs that actually hold, and handing business users tooling they can run without me.

Outside of delivery I use enterprise-approved AI tooling to audit custom applications and map end-to-end platform architecture ahead of migrations — the unglamorous documentation work that makes the risky changes survivable.

experience.summary: Platform development and migration groundwork for a large custom ServiceNow estate.
highlights: **AI-driven workflow & integration optimisation** — used enterprise-approved AI tooling and the ServiceNow SDK to audit custom applications, automate repetitive design work, and map end-to-end architecture diagrams for platform migration planning.
**Slack Spoke & multi-channel approvals** — engineered dynamic approval payloads with Flow Designer and REST integrations so requests and notifications move across platforms without manual chasing.
**Migration strategy** — documented current-state architecture and dependency maps to de-risk moving custom applications between instances.

experience.summary: End-to-end CSM and ITSM delivery: scripting, integrations, portal work and the testing around it.
highlights: **CSM & ITSM implementation** — architected and customised CSM cases alongside Incident, Problem, Change and Catalog, keeping solution design aligned to ITIL practice.
**Server & client scripting** — authored Script Includes, Business Rules, UI Policies and Glide API logic for complex CRUD operations and workflow execution.
**Flow Designer & process automation** — configured OOTB workflows and built custom flows for case routing, request fulfilment and incident auto-prioritisation.
**CMDB & API integrations** — developed eBonding integrations over REST/SOAP connecting third-party enterprise platforms to CMDB data models.
**Service Portal & UI Builder** — built and enhanced custom widgets and UI Builder components that improved external user engagement and internal support usability.
**Testing & quality assurance** — authored UAT scripts, led functional validation, and ran root-cause troubleshooting to keep the platform stable.
**Agile & governance** — participated in Agile ceremonies and stakeholder design reviews, enforcing platform controls through ACLs and secure API protocols.

projects.title: CSM–ITSM Customer Incident Communication Framework
projects.blurb: Bidirectional REST sync that keeps customers and engineers looking at the same truth.
projects.problem: Customer-facing CSM cases and internal ITSM incidents lived in separate worlds, so customers had to call in for updates that already existed inside the platform.
projects.approach: Built a bidirectional REST sync between CSM cases and ITSM incidents with mapped state models and event-driven proactive notifications.
projects.result: Real-time status parity across both records and a measurable drop in tier-1 "any update?" inquiry load.

projects.title: JIRA → ServiceNow Data Migration
projects.blurb: 200K+ records moved with reconciliation checks and no performance debt left behind.
projects.problem: 200K+ historical records sat in JIRA while delivery had already moved to ServiceNow, splitting history across two systems.
projects.approach: Wrote custom REST migration scripts on Glide APIs with batching, field mapping, reconciliation checks and post-migration query tuning.
projects.result: All 200K+ records migrated with zero data loss and no degradation in platform performance afterwards.

projects.title: eBonding & CMDB Integration Framework
projects.blurb: A reusable integration spine instead of one-off connectors.
projects.problem: Every new customer integration was written from scratch, so external data landed in CMDB inconsistently and maintenance costs compounded.
projects.approach: Designed a reusable eBonding architecture over REST/SOAP with a shared transform layer, error handling and retry semantics mapped to CMDB classes.
projects.result: New customer connections became a configuration exercise instead of a build, with consistent, trustworthy CMDB records.

projects.title: Catalog Builder Enablement
projects.blurb: Handed catalog authoring to the business without handing over the guardrails.
projects.problem: Every new catalog item — however trivial — queued behind the development team, stretching lead times for the business.
projects.approach: Configured Catalog Builder with guarded templates and supporting custom flows so non-technical owners could author and publish items within governance rails.
projects.result: Business users publish catalog items independently, and development lead time is reserved for work that genuinely needs code.

projects.title: Slack Spoke & Multi-Channel Approvals
projects.blurb: Approvals delivered where the approvers already are.
projects.problem: Approvals stalled because approvers lived in Slack while the requests lived in ServiceNow, so nothing moved until someone chased it.
projects.approach: Engineered dynamic approval payloads in Flow Designer, delivered through the Slack Spoke and REST integrations with context-aware routing.
projects.result: Approvals happen in-channel, with cross-platform notifications keeping requesters informed automatically.
